gitCommit.subject: fix(e2e): fix rename and delete canvas gallery tests
gitCommit.body:
fix(e2e): fix rename and delete canvas gallery tests

Rename test: wait for edit dialog to close (confirms save completed)
instead of a fixed 2000ms timeout that was too short on CI.

Delete test: capture baseline quota before creating canvas, then verify
create adds +1 and delete returns to baseline. Previously captured quota
only after create, which was fragile when other tests modified canvases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
